content: Dule-irwa-Babse-gormalad-e-mormar-soblesad

Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-mormar nirbadub-aradgi, nirbadub-suir-akwagiidgi, nirbadub-ginnidgi, mor sobsamalad. We-mor-yoi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dogdedamalad. Amba deyobi, Aarónʼga mor-islidikid imaksamarbalid. Igi Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogsagusa, deyob imaksamalad.
Mor-efodʼye-nugad-maklesad
Bezaleel mor-efodʼye-nugad amba deyob imaksabalid.
Degine, mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-gukingi nabir-atinned imaksamarbalid, adi, agi e-dukugi abin atogegar.
Mor-molidubga-gunaidi, mor-efodʼba-baka-mesa naid. We-mor-molidub amba deyob we-dubmargi imakarmogad:

content.text: Igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsagusa, deyob imaksamalad.

content: Akwamar-óniceʼye-nugad-nue-sobsamaladi, or-birgi sismalad. Agine, wilub-nasikega-imakdamaladyob imaksamalad. Agi Israel-masmala-e-nug nasiksamalad.
Mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-gukingi nasiksad, adi, a-akwamargi Israel-dulemar-sogambe-gakabogwad (12) insaledii guegar. Igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsagusa, deyob imaksamalad.
Mor-binasgargi-nagued-maklesad
Bezaleel, mor-binasgargi-nagued, nue-yeerdakle, mor-efodʼye-nugad-imakaledyob imaksabalid. We-dubmargi imakaled:
Deginbali, mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-sugued, degi, e-matardungued, bela emarbiid, degi, darbobalid. We-mor nubyaa-imaksale, e-sugued, degi, e-matardungued, achagwenad.
We-mor-birgine, akwamar-nuegan-ilemakar-sogabake osismalad:
Bela we-akwamar-mor-birgi-bukwadi, or-ega-imaklesad-imbaba osismalad.

Akwa-nuegana gwaambe-gakabo (12) gued, Israel-masmala-merguedba, degi, akwa-gwa-gwagwengi e-nugmar ilibali narmakar nanaid. Igi wilub-nasikega imakdamala, deyob Israel-dulemar-sogambe-gakabogwad-e-nugmar (12) egi narmakar nanaid.
Mor-binasgargi-naguedga ordub-nued sinni-sinni imaksamarbalid.
Deginbali, akwamar-e-sigoed gwabo orbi imaksamalad, degine, olua-gwabo orbi imaksamarbalid. Oluamar-gwabogwad mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-dukumar-sogbogwadgi nasiksamalad.
Geb degine, ordubmar-sinni-sinnid-giabogwad mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-dukugi-olua-gwabogwad-naidgi odosad.
Geb deginbali, amba ordubmar-sinni-sinnid-e-duku-sogbogwad ormar-sigedgi, mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-gukingi asabin nasiksamalad.
Deginbali, orbi olua-gwabo imaksamarbalid. Mor-binasgargi-nagued e-dukumar-bergunaidgi, asabin-urbalidgi nasiksamarbalid.
Deginbali, olua-gwabo orbi imaksamarbalid, mor-efodʼye-nugad-gukingi asabin urbali makaled-waliksaar, mor-sadergi-nagued-birgi-nasikega imaksamalad.

Deyobi, mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-oluamargi mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-oluamar-ebo dub-aradgi edichamalad, adi, mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-mor-sadergi-nagued-birgi, mor-binasgargi-naguedgi, mer bachikii guegar. Igi Bab-Jehová-Moisésʼga-sogsa, deyob imaksamalad.
Dule-irwa-Babse-goled-e-mormar-baigan-imaklesad
Deginbali, mor-dummad-efodʼye-nugad bela mor-aradgi nue-sobar imaksamalad.
E-negabargi, yaa-olloo nono-odogega mor-gammuga imaksamalad. Mor-gammu-e-dikarba, melle achirmakega, bela-ebilis dubgi sobsamalad.
Mor-dummad-e-nag-dukugi sapi-granada-e-sanyob-dakleged nirbadub-aradgi, nirbadub-suir-akwagiidgi, nirbadub-ginnidgi, linoʼdub-nuedgi-sobar imaksamalad.
Deginbali, gapan-burwigana olobiid imaksamarbalid. We-gapan-burwigana, bela mor-e-nag-duku-ebilis sapi-granada-e-sanyob-dakleged imba-imbagi nasiksad.

Gapan-bipigwad-gwensak, a-dikarba sapi-granada-e-sanyob-dakleged nasiksad. Deyob bela muchub-muchub mor-dummad-suitigwad e-nag-ebilis nasiksamalad. We-mor, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled, Bab-Dummadse-gornadele, ebuged. Igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsa, deyob imaksamalad.
Deginbali, Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga mor-dummad-suitigwad lino-mor-nuedgi-sobar imaksamarbalid.
Deginbali, mor-gurgin-ebirmakaled lino-mor-nuedgi, e-yeerdaklemalad imaksamarbalid. Amba linoʼdub-nuedgi garson-bipi-urba-yoleged imaksamarbalid.

Deginbali, morgo-dub-sadergi-nagued we-dubmargi sobsamarbalid: Linoʼdub-nuedgi, nirbadub-aradgi, nirbadub-suir-akwagiidgi, nirbadub-ginnidgi, ise-nue-sobar, bela-bela-nue-yeerdakle imaksamalad. Igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsa, deyob imaksamalad.
Deginbali, or-nued-matarkwaa sobsamarbalid. We-or-nued-matargwagwadgi wilub-nasikega-imakdamaladyob we-gayaburba nasiklesad: “BAB-JEHOVÁʼGA SWILIDIK-NUGSALEGALED.”
We-or-matargwagwadga dub-arad nasiksamalad. Adi, we-dub mor-gurgin-birgi atinegar. Igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsa, deyob imaksamalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-seleged-soblesad bergusad
Weyob Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged, sobsa gusmalad. We-nega bilebalid, Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-negye. Ar igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsa, deyob Israel-dulemar sobsamalad.
Ar igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga igar-uksa, bela deyobi Israel-dulemar ibmar imaksamalad.
Moisés bela ibmar-imaksamalad argasad. Ar Moisés daksagua, Israel-dulemar Bab-Jehová-sogsadba bela ibmar-imaksamala, a-dulemargi ise-nued binsasad.
